// CASE init_decl_once expect=pass
async function a1(n) {
  const seen = [];
  for (let i = await loadStart(); i < n; i++) {
    seen.push(i);
  }
  return seen;
}

// CASE cond_await_call expect=fire
async function a2() {
  const rows = [];
  for (let page = 0; await hasMore(page); page++) {
    rows.push(page);
  }
  return rows;
}

// CASE cond_await_compare expect=fire
async function a3(queue) {
  for (let i = 0; i < (await queue.size()); i++) {
    use(i);
  }
}

// CASE cond_await_compare_noparen expect=fire
async function a3b(queue) {
  for (let i = 0; i < await queue.size(); i++) {
    use(i);
  }
}

// CASE update_cursor expect=fire
async function a4(api) {
  const out = [];
  for (let page = await api.first(); page; page = await api.next(page.cursor)) {
    out.push(...page.items);
  }
  return out;
}

// CASE update_comma expect=fire
async function a5(n) {
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++, await tick()) {
    use(i);
  }
}

// CASE body_braceless_await expect=fire
async function a6(ids) {
  for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) await save(ids[i]);
}

// CASE body_braceless_push expect=fire
async function a7(ids) {
  const out = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) out.push(await load(ids[i]));
  return out;
}

// CASE body_braceless_assign expect=fire
async function a7b(ids) {
  let last;
  for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) last = await load(ids[i]);
  return last;
}

// CASE body_braceless_if expect=fire
async function a7c(ids) {
  for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) if (ids[i]) await save(ids[i]);
}

// CASE labeled_body expect=fire
async function a8(ids) {
  outer: for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
    await save(ids[i]);
  }
}

// CASE nested_inner_init_in_for_of expect=fire
async function a9(groups) {
  for (const g of groups) {
    for (let i = await firstIndex(g); i < 3; i++) {
      use(g, i);
    }
  }
}

// CASE nested_inner_init_in_classic expect=fire
async function a10(groups) {
  for (let k = 0; k < groups.length; k++) {
    for (let i = await firstIndex(groups[k]); i < 3; i++) {
      use(k, i);
    }
  }
}

// CASE nested_inner_init_in_while expect=fire
async function a11(stack) {
  while (stack.length) {
    const g = stack.pop();
    for (let i = await firstIndex(g); i < 3; i++) use(g, i);
  }
}

// CASE init_body_same_line expect=fire
async function a12(n) {
  for (let i = await loadStart(); i < n; i++) await save(i);
}

// CASE init_multi_body_next expect=fire
async function a13() {
  for (let rows = await loadRows(), i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    await save(rows[i]);
  }
}

// CASE init_assign_once expect=pass
async function a14(n) {
  let i;
  for (i = await loadStart(); i < n; i++) {
    use(i);
  }
}

// CASE init_expr_once expect=pass
async function a15(n) {
  let i = 0;
  for (await prepare(); i < n; i++) {
    use(i);
  }
}

// CASE update_optional expect=fire
async function a16(api) {
  for (let c = api.start; c; c = (await api.page(c))?.next) {
    use(c);
  }
}

// CASE cond_and_body_none expect=fire
async function a17(it) {
  for (let item; (item = await it.read()) !== null; ) {
    use(item);
  }
}

// CASE empty_header_body expect=fire
async function a18(it) {
  for (;;) {
    await it.step();
  }
}

// CASE body_try_catch expect=fire
async function a19(ids) {
  for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
    try {
      await save(ids[i]);
    } catch (e) {
      log(e);
    }
  }
}

// CASE body_nested_block expect=fire
async function a20(ids) {
  for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
    {
      const v = await load(ids[i]);
      use(v);
    }
  }
}

// CASE body_await_inside_await expect=fire
async function a21(ids) {
  for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
    await save(await load(ids[i]));
  }
}

// CASE init_closure_called_in_body expect=fire
async function a22(n) {
  for (let i = 0, get = async (k) => load(k); i < n; i++) {
    use(await get(i));
  }
}

// CASE body_else_branch expect=fire
async function a23(ids) {
  for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
    if (ids[i] === 0) continue;
    else await save(ids[i]);
  }
}
